summary: Recent complaints centre on Iglas mandi closures during paddy season, potato prices that have halved (district-wide, with Iglas-area farmers quoted), and the narrow Mursan-Iglas road where heavy vehicles jam; no completed Iglas project was found in 2024-2026 local coverage, so all five positives are sanctioned, tendered or planned items flagged as inference.

positives.english: *Approval came for widening the Mursan-Iglas road, and relief from jams is hoped for
positives.hindi: *मुरसान-इगलास सड़क चौड़ी होने की मंजूरी मिली, जाम से राहत की आस
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala Hathras (11 Oct 2026) reports the Rs 5.84 crore widening was approved by the state and says residents of Mursan, Iglas and nearby villages hope for relief. Final financial sanction is pending and no work has started, so this is not a delivered benefit. The 3 km stretch runs from Mursan (Hathras side) toward Iglas; AC membership of the stretch is unconfirmed

positives.english: *Tenders are out for bridges on the Iglas-Gorai and Iglas-Mursan roads
positives.hindi: *इगलास-गोरई और इगलास-मुरसान मार्ग पर पुल बनाने के टेंडर निकले
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala Aligarh (10 Oct 2026): PWD HQ sanctioned about Rs 7 crore for six small bridges across Iglas and Chharra ACs, and tenders are issued for all six (PWD SE). The article names an Iglas-Gorai road bridge at km 3 (Rs 2.17 crore) and an Iglas-Mursan road bridge at km 5 (Rs 2.11 crore). Tender stage only; no construction start or completion reported

positives.english: *A four-lane 8 km bypass outside Iglas town is proposed, awaiting sanction
positives.hindi: *इगलास के बाहर चार लेन बाईपास का प्रस्ताव, मंजूरी का इंतजार
positives.basis: Inference: The India Daily (updated 4 Jul 2026) reports an 8 km four-lane bypass outside Iglas town on Aligarh-Mathura SH-80, estimated at Rs 152 crore, as part of six bypasses worth Rs 703 crore. The article says the proposals are awaiting approval and have been sent to headquarters, so this is a plan, not a sanctioned or built project

positives.english: *Iglas has more than 25 cold storage centres for farm produce
positives.hindi: *इगलास में 25 से ज्यादा कोल्ड स्टोरेज केंद्र हैं
positives.basis: Inference: the Wikipedia Iglas town article says there are over 25 cold storage centres in Iglas for storing agricultural produce. The page is undated and this is an infrastructure fact, not a reported benefit, so it stays flagged. Not verified against a recent local report

positives.english: *The SSP himself walked the patrol in Iglas and assured people of safety
positives.hindi: *इगलास में एसएसपी खुद पैदल गश्त पर निकले, सुरक्षा का भरोसा दिलाया
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala Aligarh (29 Sep 2026): the SSP's foot patrol in Iglas took place on 28 Sep; he visited main markets and sensitive areas (not named), talked to people and assured them of safety. This is a police action, not a report of residents' appreciation, so it stays flagged

negatives.english: Potato prices have halved in Aligarh and farmers are not recovering their costs
negatives.hindi: आलू का भाव आधा रह गया, लागत भी नहीं निकल रही
negatives.basis: District-level, not AC-specific. Amar Ujala Aligarh (16 Mar 2026): potato prices in Aligarh roughly halved compared with last year; farmers quoted from Iglas area (Badhakalan) and other villages say costs are not being recovered; buyers stopped at Rs 200-250 per katta. Amar Ujala Aligarh (27 Jun 2026): cold storage owners asked for a Rs 200 per quintal subsidy; 135 cold storages in Aligarh district are full and farmers owe operators money

negatives.english: Rain has shut the Iglas mandi and paddy purchase is stuck
negatives.hindi: बारिश से इगलास मंडी बंद, धान की खरीद रुकी पड़ी है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala Aligarh (13 Oct 2026, 2:13 PM): Monday rain stopped paddy loading at the Iglas mandi; traders cannot buy paddy from farmers; mandi space is short; the trader association said the mandi would stay closed Tuesday and reopen Wednesday. This is a short weather closure and the article records traders' problems, not farmers' complaints

negatives.english: The narrow Mursan-Iglas road jams whenever heavy vehicles meet head-on
negatives.hindi: मुरसान-इगलास की संकरी सड़क पर भारी वाहन आमने-सामने आते ही जाम
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala Hathras (11 Oct 2026): the road is narrow so vehicle pressure is constant, and a jam forms when heavy vehicles meet head-on. The Rs 5.84 crore widening is approved but final financial sanction is pending and no work has started. The stretch runs from Mursan (Hathras side) toward Iglas; AC membership is unconfirmed and not counted as AC-specific

negatives.english: Stray cattle damage crops across Aligarh district
negatives.hindi: छुट्टा गोवंश से फसलों का नुकसान हो रहा है
negatives.basis: District-level, not AC-specific. Amar Ujala Aligarh (5 May 2026): farmers at an indefinite sit-in at the Tappal block premises said stray cattle and nandi bulls are damaging crops and demanded a ban on stray animals. Tappal is not in Iglas AC, and the article does not mention Iglas

negatives.english: After a Hathras road accident, the victim's family had to sit on dharna at the tehsil for help
negatives.hindi: हादसे के बाद पीड़ित परिवार को मदद के लिए तहसील में धरना
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala Aligarh (13 Oct 2026): villagers of Badhakhurd held a dharna at the Iglas tehsil office demanding withdrawal of a police report filed after a trailer was set on fire and the road blocked, and financial help for the family of Shivkumar alias Shiva, killed in a road accident on the Hathras road on 23 Sep, and for a seriously injured youth. The tehsil office is in Iglas town (Iglas is a town and tehsil per Wikipedia), but Badhakhurd village is not confirmed inside this AC. Counted as AC-specific by place only; no outcome reported

notes: Identity: AC No. 77 Iglas, SC, district Aligarh confirmed on the Wikipedia AC page (which covers 'the city of Iglas' with no tehsil or village list); the page's category tags list Hathras district, an inconsistency not used. Iglas town article gives conflicting population figures, not used. Searches (about 30) in Hindi and English found no completed or started Iglas project in 2024-2026 local Hindi coverage, so positives remain flagged. Excluded: Hathras city NPP drains on 'Iglas Phatak' and 'Iglas Road' (wards 9 and 15, Hathras city, different AC); Mathura-Iglas road drain (Amar Ujala Aligarh, 4 Jul 2026: no cost or location in town); Gaumat-Bajna waterlogged road (Khair direction, Iglas not named); Iglas-related 2017 Congress rally potato-unit claim (political, dated); Newstrack Iglas CHC CMO inspection (page returned 403, not read); Newstrack Iglas street play (scheme awareness, not a positive); Public App listings (aggregator, not opened) including a July 2026 Kajrauth village power outage in Iglas tehsil. Field checks: Iglas mandi after reopening; Iglas tehsil dharna outcome; tender status and start of Iglas-Gorai and Iglas-Mursan bridges; Mursan-Iglas sanction and whether the stretch is inside the AC; whether Badhakhurd and Badhakalan villages fall inside the AC; Iglas-town cattle complaints; whether the UP potato cold-storage subsidy applies in Aligarh.

round2.changes: Verified all cited URLs: AC identity (Wikipedia AC page: No. 77, Iglas, SC, Aligarh, extent 'city of Iglas'), Amar Ujala bridges, SSP, Mursan-Iglas, mandi, tehsil dharna, Wikipedia Iglas town all opened and checked. Removed 2022 Amar Ujala election page (cattle and potato-unit negatives, 2022 cycle) and Mirzapur subsidy (Mirzapur district; Aligarh/Iglas not mentioned). Replaced negatives 1, 4 and 5: potato price collapse (Aligarh, 2026, district-level) replaces the 2022 potato-unit demand; Aligarh 2026 stray-cattle report (Tappal block, district-level) replaces the 2022 cattle item; the Mursan-Iglas road jam kept (not AC-counted). Mandi item kept. Tehsil dharna kept. Positives: SSP patrol kept but flagged as police action; bridges re-worded to tender stage (sanction was for six bridges across Iglas and Chharra ACs, not all Iglas); Mirzapur subsidy removed; Wikipedia cold-storage item kept flagged; Iglas bypass plan added (The India Daily, flagged). All five positives now inference-flagged because no completed or started Iglas project was found in 2024-2026 coverage. Re-ranked negatives by likely vote impact (potato prices first).
